name: einvoice-matbao
description: Admin UI assets for the Mat Bao e-invoice plugin.

scripts.build: bun run build:css && bun run build:htmx && bun run build:checkout && bun run build:checkout-blocks
scripts.build:checkout: bun build assets/src/checkout.ts --outfile assets/dist/checkout.js --minify --target browser --format iife
scripts.build:checkout-blocks: bun build assets/src/checkout-blocks.ts --outfile assets/dist/checkout-blocks.js --minify --target browser --format iife && bun build assets/src/checkout-blocks-editor.ts --outfile assets/dist/checkout-blocks-editor.js --minify --target browser --format iife
